groups.own_dynamic_why: The record describes a selection through a formation's couplings, read at strictly increasing times from step 0, that selects alike the sampled levels with and without a part beyond the coupling closure as read there, that closure lying within the coupling closure. The store has this going-on under unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure (family B), whose mechanism says: "With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what couples into members of a formation's coupling closure, and every member of the part beyond it, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike." What the coarser reading adds is where the closure lies (a requirement that holds only at a skipped step couples nothing in), which is that dynamic's own condition. Its open says "the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector". recurring-at-fine-steps-quiet-at-coarser has readings at coarser steps, but of another going-on: "Read at strictly increasing times, with activity decided, arising or ceasing at arbitrarily late coarse steps is arising or ceasing at arbitrarily late fine steps." No statement of the module is of arising, ceasing or rest. In Missed the sampled levels differ at a step read (coarse_differs), so the case is not one of a change that the reading does not show. The record's own 'does not show' excludes a rule set again, the pace of a reading and a turn in time. No dynamic of its own.

listings.entry_quote: With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, balance at each step on what couples into members of a formation's coupling closure, and every member of the part beyond it, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike.

With l the levels without the part, balance on what couples in at the coarser steps, and every member of the part beyond the closure read at σ, every selection through the couplings read at σ of a formation within that closure gives select (atTimes σ W.level) ↔ select (atTimes σ l). It states the blindness itself and would be on this list however it were proved.

listings.entry_quote: Every selection through a selector's couplings selects two histories alike exactly when they are alike through those couplings (near-definitional); that an actual selection goes through them is supplied. [...] what a pool outside the acting part decides by its acts, under laws reading through its members' couplings, is a selection through its pooled coupling.
listings.why: Statement: (W.sample σ).SelectsThrough obs g t select gives W.SelectsThrough obs g (σ t) (fun l => select (atTimes σ l)), σ strict. It says which selections are selections through a selector's couplings: one read at coarser steps is one. It has the same form as the entry's sentence on a pool's acts (ExchangeLaw.Through.selectsThroughAll, already listed). Its proof term uses only AlikeThroughUpTo.sample; it is a case of nothing.

listings.entry_quote: A group's closure is the union of its members' [...] The bound has content only for a pool that leaves some returning formation out: on a finite flow with reach decided every formation lies within the influence closure of a formation whose acts return, so within their pooled coupling closure
listings.why: Statement: (L.sample σ).WithinCoupling (W.sample σ) obs f g → L.WithinCoupling W obs f g. It is a law of how far the coupling closure reaches, here under a coarser reading: no less lies beyond the closure read there. The entry states and lists laws of the closure's reach as its own (withinClosureOf_iff, Flow.covered_by_returning), and the closure is this dynamic's term in the store.

listings.entry_quote: A group's closure is the union of its members' [...] (open) The more couples in, the larger the coupling closure and the smaller the gap: the law's force lies entirely in what actually couples into the selector.
listings.why: Statement: σ strict and from step 0, and every dependence a dependence at some step read, give L.WithinCoupling W obs f g → (L.sample σ).WithinCoupling (W.sample σ) obs f g. It says when the closure read at coarser steps is no smaller: the gap grows only through a requirement that holds at no step read. It states the closure's reach by what couples in, the entry's own condition.

groups.own_dynamic_why: The record describes a way and a level on TurningInTime's pair: the way steps as it was outside the marked levels and is set to one fixed correction at a marked level. Over every marking silent at the start's level, it says when the line never ends: exactly where the level of the course as it was, one step after it first differs from the start's, is at or above H2 + y2. The store has this going-on under turning-in-time (family A): "Outside a set of marked levels the way after a step is a given function of the way alone (AloneOutside); up to the first marked level of the course as it was, the course is that course. [...] With decided marks, the way after a marked step of a kind every step keeps, every way of which uses exactly H2, [...] the line never ends exactly where, at the first marked step with the need met there and before, the level of the course as it was one step later is at or above H2 + y2." The record's laws are that law with the marks ranged over and the correction supplied. The entry's open already says "How the marked levels, the need and the kept kind come to stand [...]: here they are premises, not derived", and the record derives none of them. The module's account says "No older law is made a case here" and the record says it shows no law of Becoming.TurningInTime as a case. Same pair, same line, same threshold and same one-step lag: no dynamic of its own.

Its entry lists the four under the stronger premises (TurningInTime.turned_meets_iff, recoverable_iff_above, noReturnAt_iff_first_below, noReturnAt_of_below), two of them with premise rows, and its open says: "Its point of no return of a course (Recoverable, NoReturnAt) is used, with the turns of a level course to one standing use as the feasible courses and the need met at every step as what is asked (recoverable_iff_above, noReturnAt_iff_first_below, turns_in_time_iff_before); other continuations are not among the feasible courses."
